name: zutil_zbd_flush_temp_write_stream_to_section_record
description: zUtil_ZBD::FlushTempWriteStreamToSectionRecord dispatches an active temp stream to the global ZBD manager and is a no-op when no manager is active.
binary_ninja_evidence: 0x4c00a0 preserves the fastcall tmpStream/callbackCtx arguments, checks g_zUtil_ZbdManager, and calls zZbdManager::FlushTempStreamToSectionRecord(manager, tmpStream, callbackCtx, sectionToken) only when the manager is non-null.
known_limits: code/function tier S byte verification remains deferred to a coherent zUtil ZBD temp-write source-cluster pass.
